## Wi-Fi

### Wi-Fi throughput tuning (MT7925) {#wifi-mt7925}

No PCIe ASPM, no Wi-Fi power saving, a bigger AQL queue: about double the speed

- **Handleiding:** [MT7925 Wifi-prestaties]({{< relref "/docs/networking/mt7925-wifi-performance" >}})
- **Alleen op:** een machine met de MediaTek MT7925 Wi-Fi-kaart
- **Label:** Aanbevolen
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3351-L3354) · [`on_mt7925`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1240-L1242) · [`off_mt7925`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1245-L1247)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Apply the Wi-Fi tuning with mt7925-tune.py (checked against the SHA-256 built into this setup)
python3 mt7925-tune.py enable
# mt7925-tune.py is the copy next to quicksetup.py, or else
#   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/main/src/static/scripts/mt7925-tune.py
# It only runs when its SHA-256 is cf5aa114d872c6480525b55f637fab346337f9cbbdce9657e0688fd48cac1247
#   which is the one published at https://zephyrus-linux.thectic.nl/scripts/mt7925-tune.py
# It asks for your password once and changes, as root:
#   /etc/modprobe.d/mt7925e.conf:  options mt7925e disable_aspm=1   (read at boot, so this needs a reboot)
#   /etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/wifi-powersave.conf:  [connection] wifi.powersave = 2   (then it restarts NetworkManager)
#   /sys/kernel/debug/ieee80211/<phy>/aql_txq_limit:  2 20000 40000   (live, and gone again after a reboot)
```

- Herstart nodig: PCIe ASPM.

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Revert the Wi-Fi tuning with mt7925-tune.py (checked against the SHA-256 built into this setup)
python3 mt7925-tune.py disable
# mt7925-tune.py is the copy next to quicksetup.py, or else
#   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/main/src/static/scripts/mt7925-tune.py
# It only runs when its SHA-256 is cf5aa114d872c6480525b55f637fab346337f9cbbdce9657e0688fd48cac1247
#   which is the one published at https://zephyrus-linux.thectic.nl/scripts/mt7925-tune.py
# It asks for your password once and changes, as root:
#   removes /etc/modprobe.d/mt7925e.conf and /etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/wifi-powersave.conf, then restarts NetworkManager
#   rfkill unblock bluetooth   (in case the optional --bluetooth-off had been used)
#   /sys/kernel/debug/ieee80211/<phy>/aql_txq_limit:  2 5000 12000   (the stock values)
```

- Herstart nodig: reverting the PCIe ASPM override.

## Campus

### eduroam at Saxion {#eduroam-saxion}

Connects to eduroam with the right pinned certificates. Saxion only

- **Handleiding:** [eduroam Netwerkinstallatie]({{< relref "/docs/networking/eduroam-network-installation" >}})
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3355-L3357) · [`on_eduroam`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1275-L1278) · [`off_eduroam`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1281-L1285)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Set up eduroam with saxion-eduroam.py in a terminal window (it asks for your login)
python3 saxion-eduroam.py
# saxion-eduroam.py is the copy next to quicksetup.py, or else
#   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/main/src/static/scripts/saxion-eduroam.py
# It only runs when its SHA-256 is c037f0fc7e282b8e9126e7646d87b5b50069d69e60053d22d4792c88b5bb89a8
#   which is the one published at https://zephyrus-linux.thectic.nl/scripts/saxion-eduroam.py
# It asks for your Saxion login in the terminal window, then, as you:
#   writes the pinned certificate authority to ~/.config/saxion-eduroam/saxion-eduroam-ca.pem (mode 600)
#   nmcli connection delete eduroam   (an old profile of that name goes first)
#   nmcli connection add type wifi con-name eduroam ssid eduroam wifi-sec.key-mgmt wpa-eap 802-1x.eap peap 802-1x.phase2-auth mschapv2 ...
#       802-1x.identity <your Saxion login>  802-1x.anonymous-identity anonymous@saxion.nl
#       802-1x.domain-suffix-match ise.infra.saxion.net  802-1x.ca-cert <the file above>  connection.permissions user:<you>
#   nmcli --wait 45 connection up eduroam, then nmcli connection modify eduroam connection.autoconnect yes
# The password is asked for by your desktop keyring and stored there, never in a file.
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Remove the eduroam connection
nmcli connection delete eduroam

# Remove the pinned certificate authority the setup wrote
rm -f /home/your-username/.config/saxion-eduroam/saxion-eduroam-ca.pem
rmdir /home/your-username/.config/saxion-eduroam 2>/dev/null || true
```
